slots.jd.tax-firm.about:
About us and the job
Redwood Tax and Bookkeeping is a small, owner-run accounting firm in Sacramento, California. We keep the books, prepare taxes and help local businesses stay on top of their finances. We are hiring a Staff Accountant to join our team. The job is on site in our office, and you will work closely with the owners and our small staff on client accounts.
slots.jd.tax-firm.duties:
What the job involves
- Prepare monthly financial statements for our small business clients
- Review vendor invoices for accuracy, coding and approval before payment
- Reconcile client bank and credit card accounts and clear any differences
- Post journal entries and adjustments as needed
- Help with month-end close and keep client files organised
slots.jd.tax-firm.needs:
What you need
- 1 or more years of experience in accounting or bookkeeping
- Working knowledge of journal entries, month-end close and budget variance analysis
- Experience with fixed asset tracking and sales tax filing
- Comfort working in SAP
- Bookkeeping Certificate (required)
- Certified Public Accountant Licence (preferred)
slots.r1.b1: Supports audit preparation by organising payroll accounting records and tying them to the general ledger, cutting auditor follow-up requests by 10 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Reconciles bank accounts each month and matches asset purchases against fixed asset tracking schedules so balances agree before review.
slots.r1.b3: Builds Microsoft Excel checklists and tie-out workbooks for month-end close, reducing the time needed to finish closing entries by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Prepares draft financial statements from posted journal entries and supporting schedules for review by a colleague.
slots.r1.i1: Prepares monthly financial statements and supporting schedules as a Staff Accountant at Northfield Group.
slots.r1.i2: Reviews vendor invoices for accuracy and approval before payment as a Staff Accountant at Northfield Group.
slots.summary.1: Associate-level accountant with about 1 year of experience handling routine accounting requests, with a colleague checking the work. Uses Microsoft Excel for schedules and reconciliations and records journal entries and payroll accounting entries with care.
slots.summary.2: Associate-level accountant with a B.S. in Accounting and about 1 year in a staff accountant role, handling routine requests while a colleague reviews the work. Works daily in Microsoft Excel, prepares journal entries, and supports payroll accounting and month-end close.
